tools.name: get_week_rankings
tools.description: Return published weekly fantasy football rankings for one position, week, and scoring format. Use this for start/sit comparisons or a ranked position list. This tool does not support basketball.

tools.name: get_season_rankings
tools.description: Return a paginated Ball Ranks season ranking board for fantasy basketball or football. Basketball uses nine-category per-game rankings; football accepts standard, half-PPR, or PPR scoring.

tools.name: get_player_rankings
tools.description: Look up one player's published Ball Ranks season ranking by player ID or slug. Use this when the user asks where a specific player ranks.

tools.name: get_player_projections
tools.description: Look up one player's published season projection, or a weekly football projection, by player ID or slug. Weekly projections require scope=weekly and a week number.
